summary: Official measurement and boundary pegging by government revenue surveyor (Kanungo/Patwari) to resolve boundary disputes.

steps.title: Obtain latest Jamabandi and Sajra (Map)
steps.description: Procure certified computerized land records (Fard) and village cadastral map from revenue center.

steps.title: Apply to Tehsildar for Nishandehi
steps.description: Submit demarcation application citing Khasra/Killa numbers and adjoining landowner details.

steps.title: Notice to adjoining boundary owners
steps.description: Tehsildar issues written notices summoning owners of all four adjacent plots to be present on site.

steps.title: Field measurement by Kanungo & ETS/DGPS
steps.description: Revenue team measures from fixed benchmark points using Electronic Total Station / metric chain.

steps.title: Boundary stone fixation & report sign-off
steps.description: Fix boundary pegs in presence of all parties; prepare Panchnama report signed by panchas.
